goal: Provider membership scope hardening (multi-tenant negative tests and zero parameter trusting)
summary: Hardened provider membership scope enforcement in RBPC partner inbox endpoints (list_partner_inquiries and update_partner_inquiry_status). Caller identity is derived strictly from get_current_user without trusting client query parameters like ?provider=... for horizontal privilege escalation. Implemented comprehensive multi-tenant negative tests verifying Provider A cannot read or tamper with Provider B's inquiries (returning 403 FORBIDDEN_SCOPE), unauthenticated callers receive 401 Unauthorized, and administrators retain authorized cross-tenant visibility and management.

identity_resolution.client_param_trusting: ZERO. Any client parameter (such as ?provider=...) is strictly disregarded for non-admin callers.

tenant_scoping.patch_ownership_check: inquiry.provider_id == current_user.id or (experience is not None and experience.provider_id == current_user.id)

unauthorized_patch_error.message: You do not have permission to manage this inquiry.

role_matrix.non_admin_provider: Strict tenant isolation: read own inquiries, patch own inquiries with valid lifecycle transitions, 403 on cross-tenant patch
role_matrix.admin: Cross-tenant inquiry read, optional ?provider=<uuid> filter, and cross-tenant update capability
